Body.Content:
What and Why:

We’re updating the command bar experience for SharePoint Pages. This update reorders the +New menu structure, makes changes to labels, and adds more prominent page state indicators for visibility whether a page is live.

Rollout Schedule:

General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout begins in early August 2026 and is expected to complete by late August 2026.

Impact on your organization:

Who is affected:

  • Site owners or Site Managers with edit permission. These changes do not affect users with Site visitor permissions only. 

What will happen:

  • Command bar menu reordering and label updates for pages and news posts:
    • Save and Close is now labeled Save and Exit.
    • Edit (for navigation changes) is now labeled Edit Navigation.
    • List Forms is no longer a standalone menu item in +New; it is available under the List menu option.
  • We’re adding a page status indicator to the command bar so authors can quickly see whether a page is Draft or Published:
    • Draft: the page has not been published.
    • Published: the page is live, with the date it was published.
    • Draft; previously published on date: the page was previously published and has unpublished draft edits.
    • This status label doesn’t publish or unpublish content; authors still use Publish to make changes live.
  • Existing pages and content are not modified by this update.
  • This is a service user interface (UI) update and is available by default as it rolls out.

Action Required/Recommendations:

No admin action is required.

  • Update internal documentation or training materials to reflect the new labels (Save and Exit, Edit Navigation) and the new page state indicator.
  • Notify SharePoint content owners/page authors about the UI changes to reduce help desk tickets.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified, review as appropriate for your organization.

Title: SharePoint Pages: Command bar menu and page state indicator updates
